title: Royal Vanilla + SERVER
description: Royal Vanilla + SERVER / BAREBONES is a minimal Vanilla+ Fabric modpack designed for servers and low-end systems, including only essential gameplay and world-generation mods with no client-side visuals.
body:
# Royal Vanilla + SERVER / BAREBONES

**Royal Vanilla + SERVER / BAREBONES** is a minimal Vanilla+ Fabric modpack for Minecraft (Currently)-**1.21.5**, designed specifically for servers, shared worlds, and low-end systems.

This version removes all shaders, resource packs, and client-only mods, keeping only essential server-side and gameplay-focused mods.

---

## What You’ll Experience

- **Server-focused design** — Built for multiplayer and long-term worlds  
- **Extremely lightweight** — Minimal client requirements and resource usage  
- **Vanilla+ mechanics** — Enhanced terrain, structures, and gameplay systems  
- **No client visuals** — No shaders, textures, or visual-only mods  
- **Highly flexible** — Designed to pair with external client-side packs  

---

## About the Pack

Royal Vanilla + SERVER / BAREBONES acts as a **clean foundation** for servers or players who want full control over their client setup.

As part of my **first modpack project**, it has been tested for stability and compatibility, with future updates focused on reliability and performance.

---

## Conclusion

Royal Vanilla + SERVER / BAREBONES provides a stable, minimal Vanilla+ base — perfect for servers or players on very low-end hardware.

---
